agencies.name: Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange
agencies.description: SDMX is an initiative to foster standards for the exchange of statistical information. It is sponsored by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS), the European Central Bank (ECB), the Statistical Office of the European Union (Eurostat), the International Monetary Fund (IMF), the Organization for Economic Co-Operation and Development (OECD), the United Nations (UN) and the World Bank.

agencies.name: United Nations Statistics Division
agencies.description: The Statistics Division of the Department of Economic and Social Affairs of the United Nations Secretariat (UNSD) is committed to the advancement of the global statistical system. UNSD compiles and disseminates global statistical information, develops standards and norms for statistical activities, and supports countries' efforts to strengthen their national statistical systems. UNSD facilitates the coordination of international statistical activities and supports the functioning of the United Nations Statistical Commission as the apex entity of the global statistical system.

agencies.name: United Nations Organization for Education, Science and Culture

names.en: United Nations Organization for Education, Science and Culture

agencies.description:
The United Nations Organization for Education, Science and Culture (UNESCO) was founded on 16 November 1945.

            UNESCO has 195 Members and eight Associate Members. It is governed by the General Conference and the Executive Board. The Secretariat, headed by the Director-General, implements the decisions of these two bodies.

            The Organization has more than 50 field offices around the world. Its headquarters are located at Place de Fontenoy in Paris, France, in in an outstanding, Modernist building inaugurated in 1958 and recently renovated.

codes.name: Free
codes.description: It is used for observations for which there are no special sensitivity considerations and which can be freely shared. Please note: In some institutional environments the term "unclassified" is used in a sense that still denotes implied restrictions in the circulation of information. If this is the case, this organisation may probably consider that "free" (value F) is not the appropriate corresponding tag for this kind of "unclassified" category and it may be that "non-publishable / restricted" (value N) may be more appropriate. The focus of this code is not to describe and anticipate all potential permissible uses (e.g. permission to re-disseminate). Thus, the use of "F" does not allow safe assumptions with respect to the permission to "re-disseminate" (freely or at a price) the received or accessed information (e.g. on web or paper), especially on a massive and regular basis (legal and copyright constraints may apply). Usually, source organisations provide information and guidance on re-dissemination issues, either on their websites or on their paper publications.

codes.description: Confidential statistical information (primary confidentiality) due to identifiable respondents. Measures also should be taken to prevent not only direct access, but also indirect deduction or calculation by other users and parties, probably by considering and treating additional observations as "confidential" (secondary confidentiality management).

codes.name: Secondary confidentiality set by the sender, not for publication

names.en: Secondary confidentiality set by the sender, not for publication

codes.description: Used by the sender of the data to flag (beyond the confidential statistical information) one or more additional observations of the dataset so that the receiver knows that he/she should suppress these observations in subsequent stages of processing (especially, dissemination) in order to prevent third parties to indirectly deduct (e.g. through accounting identities or other formulas) the observations that are genuinely flagged with "C".

names.en: Full coverage with vitamin A supplements is reported as the lower percentage of 2 annual coverage points (i.e., lower point between semester 1 (January–June) and semester 2 (July–December) of 2017. Data are only presented for VAS priority countries; thus aggregates are only based on and representative of these priority countries.
names.es: La cobertura total con suplementos de vitamina A se notifica como el porcentaje más bajo de 2 puntos de cobertura anual de 2017 (es decir, el punto más bajo entre el semestre 1 (enero-junio) y el semestre 2 (julio-diciembre)). Los datos solo se presentan para los países prioritarios de la administración de suplementos de vitamina A; por lo tanto, los agregados solo se basan en estos países prioritarios y son representativos de ellos.
names.fr: La couverture totale en ce qui concerne les suppléments de vitamine A est présentée comme le pourcentage le plus faible de deux points de couverture annuels (c’est-à-dire le point le plus faible entre le premier semestre [de janvier à juin] et le deuxième semestre [de juillet à décembre] de 2017). Les données ne sont présentées que pour les pays prioritaires pour la supplémentation en vitamine A. Les agrégats ne sont donc basés que sur ces pays prioritaires et ne représentent qu’eux.

codes.name: Global and regional averages for stunting (moderate and severe), overweight (moderate and severe),wasting (moderate and severe) and wasting (severe) are estimated using statistical modelling data from the UNICEF-WHO-World Bank Group Joint Child Malnutrition Estimates, March 2019 Edition. For more information see <data.unicef.org/malnutrition>. Disaggregations for stunting (moderate and severe) are population-weighted, which means using the most recent estimate for each country with data between 2013 and 2018; therefore disaggregations may not coincide with total estimates at the global and regional level presented in this table.

names.en: Global and regional averages for stunting (moderate and severe), overweight (moderate and severe),wasting (moderate and severe) and wasting (severe) are estimated using statistical modelling data from the UNICEF-WHO-World Bank Group Joint Child Malnutrition Estimates, March 2019 Edition. For more information see <data.unicef.org/malnutrition>. Disaggregations for stunting (moderate and severe) are population-weighted, which means using the most recent estimate for each country with data between 2013 and 2018; therefore disaggregations may not coincide with total estimates at the global and regional level presented in this table.
names.fr: Les moyennes régionales et mondiales pour le retard de croissance (modéré et sévère), le surpoids (modéré et sévère) et l’émaciation (sévère) sont estimées grâce à des modélisations statistiques des données issues des estimations communes de l’UNICEF, de l’OMS et du Groupe de la Banque mondiale sur la malnutrition infantile mises à jour en mars 2019. Les données ventilées pour le retard de croissance (modéré et sévère) sont pondérées en fonction de la population, ce qui signifie que les estimations les plus récentes sont utilisées pour chaque pays pour lequel des données sont disponibles entre 2013 et 2018. Pour cette raison, les données ventilées peuvent ne pas correspondre aux estimations totales aux niveaux mondial et régional présentées dans ce tableau.

codes.name: For stunting, wasting and severe wasting estimates, the Northern America regional average is based only on United States data; The Australia and New Zealand regional estimates for stunting and overweight are based only on Australian data.

codes.name: Labour force participation rate

names.es: Tasa de participación de la fuerza laboral

codes.description: The labour force participation rate is calculated as the labour force during a given reference period expressed as a percentage of the working-age population in the same reference period. The labour force (formerly known as currently active population) comprises all persons of working age who furnish the supply of labour for the production of goods and services (as defined by the United Nations System of National Accounts (SNA) production boundary) during a specified time-reference period. It is measured in relation to a short reference period such as one week or one day. It refers to the sum of all persons of working age who are employed and those who are unemployed

descriptions.en: The labour force participation rate is calculated as the labour force during a given reference period expressed as a percentage of the working-age population in the same reference period. The labour force (formerly known as currently active population) comprises all persons of working age who furnish the supply of labour for the production of goods and services (as defined by the United Nations System of National Accounts (SNA) production boundary) during a specified time-reference period. It is measured in relation to a short reference period such as one week or one day. It refers to the sum of all persons of working age who are employed and those who are unemployed
descriptions.ar: يتم احتساب معدل المشاركة في القوى العاملة على أنه القوة العاملة خلال فترة مرجعية معينة معبرًا عنها كنسبة مئوية من السكان في سن العمل في نفس الفترة المرجعية. تتألف القوة العاملة (المعروفة سابقًا باسم السكان النشطين حاليًا) من جميع الأشخاص في سن العمل الذين يقدمون العمالة اللازمة لإنتاج السلع والخدمات (على النحو المحدد في حدود إنتاج نظام الأمم المتحدة للحسابات القومية (SNA)) خلال فترة محددة. فترة الإسناد الزمني. يتم قياسه بالنسبة لفترة مرجعية قصيرة مثل أسبوع واحد أو يوم واحد. يشير إلى مجموع جميع الأشخاص في سن العمل المستخدمين والعاطلين عن العمل
descriptions.es: La tasa de participación en la fuerza de trabajo se calcula como la fuerza de trabajo durante un período de referencia dado expresada como un porcentaje de la población en edad de trabajar en el mismo período de referencia. La fuerza laboral (antes conocida como población actualmente activa) comprende a todas las personas en edad de trabajar que proporcionan la oferta de mano de obra para la producción de bienes y servicios (según lo define el límite de producción del Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de las Naciones Unidas (SCN)) durante un período especificado. período de referencia de tiempo. Se mide en relación con un período de referencia corto, como una semana o un día. Se refiere a la suma de todas las personas en edad de trabajar que están empleadas y las que están desempleadas.
descriptions.fr: Le taux d'activité est calculé comme la population active au cours d'une période de référence donnée exprimée en pourcentage de la population en âge de travailler au cours de la même période de référence. La population active (anciennement connue sous le nom de population active) comprend toutes les personnes en âge de travailler qui fournissent la main-d'œuvre pour la production de biens et de services (telle que définie par la limite de production du Système de comptabilité nationale (SCN) des Nations Unies) pendant une période donnée. période de référence. Il est mesuré par rapport à une courte période de référence telle qu'une semaine ou un jour. Il se réfère à la somme de toutes les personnes en âge de travailler qui ont un emploi et de celles qui sont au chômage

codes.name: Refugees
codes.description: Persons who have current refugee status, granted either before arrival or upon arrival in the receiving country. Those with status granted before arrival in the receiving country include resettled refugees, and those who were living abroad at the time of application and whose application for permanent residence was considered concurrently with that of the protected person already living in the country. Refugee status can be granted on the basis of the 1951 Convention and the 1967 Protocol or pertinent regional instruments. The group may also include persons who qualify as refugees under national legal systems. Only refugees under the UNHCR mandate are covered here

descriptions.en: Persons who have current refugee status, granted either before arrival or upon arrival in the receiving country. Those with status granted before arrival in the receiving country include resettled refugees, and those who were living abroad at the time of application and whose application for permanent residence was considered concurrently with that of the protected person already living in the country. Refugee status can be granted on the basis of the 1951 Convention and the 1967 Protocol or pertinent regional instruments. The group may also include persons who qualify as refugees under national legal systems. Only refugees under the UNHCR mandate are covered here
descriptions.ar: الأشخاص الذين يتمتعون بوضع اللاجئ الحالي ، يتم منحهم إما قبل الوصول أو عند الوصول إلى البلد المستقبِل. يشمل أولئك الذين حصلوا على الوضع الممنوح قبل الوصول إلى البلد المستقبِل اللاجئين المعاد توطينهم ، وأولئك الذين كانوا يعيشون في الخارج وقت تقديم الطلب والذين تم النظر في طلبهم للحصول على الإقامة الدائمة بالتزامن مع طلب الشخص المحمي الذي يعيش بالفعل في البلد. يمكن منح وضع اللاجئ على أساس اتفاقية عام 1951 وبروتوكول عام 1967 أو الصكوك الإقليمية ذات الصلة. قد تشمل المجموعة أيضًا الأشخاص المؤهلين كلاجئين بموجب الأنظمة القانونية الوطنية. يتم تغطية اللاجئين فقط بموجب تفويض المفوضية السامية للأمم المتحدة لشؤون اللاجئين هنا
descriptions.es: Personas que tienen el estatus de refugiado actual, otorgado antes de la llegada o al llegar al país de recepción. Aquellos con estatus otorgado antes de la llegada al país de recepción incluyen refugiados reasentados y aquellos que estaban viviendo en el extranjero en el momento de la solicitud y cuya solicitud de residencia permanente se consideró al mismo tiempo que la de la persona protegida que ya vivía en el país. El estatuto de refugiado puede concederse sobre la base de la Convención de 1951 y el Protocolo de 1967 o de los instrumentos regionales pertinentes. El grupo también puede incluir personas que califican como refugiados bajo los sistemas legales nacionales. Aquí solo se tratan los refugiados bajo el mandato del ACNUR
descriptions.fr: Les personnes qui ont le statut de réfugié actuel, accordé soit avant l'arrivée, soit à l'arrivée dans le pays d'accueil. Les personnes dont le statut a été accordé avant l'arrivée dans le pays d'accueil comprennent les réfugiés réinstallés et ceux qui vivaient à l'étranger au moment de la demande et dont la demande de résidence permanente a été examinée en même temps que celle de la personne protégée résidant déjà dans le pays. Le statut de réfugié peut être accordé sur la base de la Convention de 1951 et du Protocole de 1967 ou d'instruments régionaux pertinents. Le groupe peut également inclure des personnes qui remplissent les conditions pour être réfugiées dans les systèmes juridiques nationaux. Seuls les réfugiés relevant du mandat du HCR sont couverts ici

codes.description: Number of legal instruments related to children and international migration ratified by each country. The legal instruments refer to: (a) the 1989 Convention on the Rights of the Child; (b) the 1951 Convention relating to the Status of Refugees and the 1967 Protocol Relating to the Status of Refugees; (c) the 2000 Protocol to Prevent, Suppress and Punish Trafficking in Persons, Especially Women and Children; (d) the 2000 Protocol against the Smuggling of Migrants by Land, Sea and Air; and (e) the 1990 International Convention on the Protection of the Rights of All Migrant Workers and Members of Their Families.

descriptions.en: Number of legal instruments related to children and international migration ratified by each country. The legal instruments refer to: (a) the 1989 Convention on the Rights of the Child; (b) the 1951 Convention relating to the Status of Refugees and the 1967 Protocol Relating to the Status of Refugees; (c) the 2000 Protocol to Prevent, Suppress and Punish Trafficking in Persons, Especially Women and Children; (d) the 2000 Protocol against the Smuggling of Migrants by Land, Sea and Air; and (e) the 1990 International Convention on the Protection of the Rights of All Migrant Workers and Members of Their Families.
descriptions.ar: عدد الصكوك القانونية المتعلقة بالأطفال والهجرة الدولية التي صادق عليها كل بلد. تشير الصكوك القانونية إلى: (أ) اتفاقية حقوق الطفل لعام 1989 ؛ (ب) اتفاقية عام 1951 المتعلقة بمركز اللاجئين وبروتوكول عام 1967 المتعلق بمركز اللاجئين ؛ (ج) بروتوكول عام 2000 لمنع وقمع ومعاقبة الاتجار بالأشخاص ، وبخاصة النساء والأطفال ؛ (د) بروتوكول عام 2000 لمكافحة تهريب المهاجرين عن طريق البر والبحر والجو ؛ (هـ) الاتفاقية الدولية لحماية حقوق جميع العمال المهاجرين وأفراد أسرهم لعام 1990 ".
descriptions.es: Número de instrumentos legales relacionados con la niñez y la migración internacional ratificados por cada país. Los instrumentos legales se refieren a: (a) la Convención sobre los Derechos del Niño de 1989; (b) la Convención de 1951 sobre el Estatuto de los Refugiados y el Protocolo de 1967 sobre el Estatuto de los Refugiados; c) el Protocolo de 2000 para prevenir, reprimir y sancionar la trata de personas, especialmente mujeres y niños; d) Protocolo de 2000 contra el tráfico ilícito de migrantes por tierra, mar y aire; y (e) la Convención Internacional sobre la Protección de los Derechos de Todos los Trabajadores Migratorios y de sus Familiares de 1990.
descriptions.fr: Nombre d'instruments juridiques relatifs aux enfants et aux migrations internationales ratifiés par chaque pays. Les instruments juridiques font référence: a) à la Convention de 1989 relative aux droits de l’enfant; b) la Convention de 1951 relative au statut des réfugiés et le Protocole de 1967 relatif au statut des réfugiés; c) le Protocole de 2000 visant à prévenir, réprimer et punir la traite des personnes, en particulier des femmes et des enfants; d) le Protocole de 2000 contre le trafic illicite de migrants par terre, air et mer; et e) la Convention internationale de 1990 sur la protection des droits de tous les travailleurs migrants et des membres de leur famille.
